verdict.rationale: Mise's docs show that config/tasks live in plain text files that can be checked into git (mise-docs-19, mise-docs-48) and that tool installs can be pinned via a lockfile (mise-docs-70), but there is no evidence of a built-in versioning, diff/review, or rollback mechanism for tasks/automations themselves — that relies entirely on external git tooling, which the evidence never describes as an integrated mise feature.
